param_change: the template param_change

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_param_change.Rd

The table template param_change, layout summary. Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(ard, "param_change", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
populationrequiredcalloutput.populationthe analysis set's id (SAF)
subsetothercallwhich subjects (R, on the analysis set's ADSL): PART == "Part 1"
datarequiredcallthe BDS dataset (ADLB, ADVS, ADEG)
paramsothercallthe PARAMCD values, in the data's order; NULL: all
visitsothercallthe AVISIT values; NULL: all
whereothercallthe records kept (R), e.g. ANL01FL == "Y"
byothercallTRT01Asettings.treatmentthe column variable
layoutothercallcolscols: each arm's value and change side by side; rows: the value's rows, then the change's, under each visit
param_orderothercallPARAMNthe parameters' order variable; NULL: by name
visit_orderothercallAVISITNthe visits' order variable; NULL: by name
baselineothercallFALSETRUE: the baseline's rows (BASE) before the value's
baseline_labelothercallBaselinethe baseline's heading
value_labelothercallValuethe value's heading
change_labelothercallChange from baselinethe change's heading
data_idothercallthe analysis data's id; NULL: _
data_labelothercallthe analysis data's label
statisticsothercallN, mean, sd, median, min, maxthe statistics the ARD has
cellsothercalln = {N:.0f}; Mean (SD) = {mean:.1f} ({sd:.2f}); Median = ...plan_cells.continuousthe rows of a value or a change
param_pageothercallTRUETRUE: a page a parameter, named in the titles by 'param_heading'
param_headingothercallParameter: {value}a parameter's page name ('{value}': the parameter)

Aliases

The same template by the names of other collections' items: each runs it as itself (tfl_tpl(x, "phuse_ct_summary", ...)).

AliasCollectionItemTitle
phuse_ct_summaryPhUSE CSSCT tableObserved values and change by visit
ars_vs_chg_hCDISC ARS14-3-3-1aVital signs values and change horizontal
ars_vs_chg_vCDISC ARS14-3-3-1bVital signs values and change vertical

The aliases follow the numbering of these publications, and the titles are short descriptions of our own, not their text. The templates are tflspec's, not endorsed or recommended by PhUSE or CDISC.

Example

plan <- tfl_tpl(ard, "param_change", population = "SAF", data = "ADLB", params = c("ALT", "AST"), where = "ANL01FL == \"Y\"")

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

tfl_tpl_help("param_change", tier = c("required", "usual"))
